scope: how often each project's token cap binds, on the same tuple entries. Derived from the frozen A1 source receipt; no new source read.

typed_objects.derivation: lower = P(blobs >= 33); upper = P(blobs >= 23) using this file's observed maxima (photons 2, prongs 7) plus one muon. The joint multiplicity is not in the receipt, so only a bracket is derivable.
lower = P(blobs >= 33); upper = P(blobs >= 18) using this file's observed maxima (photons 2, prongs 12) plus one muon. The joint multiplicity is not in the receipt, so only a bracket is derivable.

qualifications: These are UNSELECTED tuple entries, one file per role, unweighted. The production selection and POT weighting are not applied, so these fractions do not determine the selected-population behaviour.
A lower token count is not equivalent information. Whether reconstructed objects preserve what the raw cluster cloud carries is NOT measured here and is the prerequisite for any adoption.
The typed binding fraction is a bracket, not a point, because the receipt holds marginal and not joint family multiplicities.
